title: forms: a field whose `defaultValue` is a CEL expression opens empty on a new record with no sign that the server will fill it on save
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect measured at a public door (findings A-20, B-11; the CEL half). Filed by the triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`), splitting objectstack-ai/objectstack#22722 (the maintainer's HotCRM browser pass, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2058, measured on `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Read on objectui `main` `ce991bd70f`

- `packages/plugin-form/src/schemaDefaults.ts` (`schemaDefaultValues`, `isSeedableDefault`, and the docblock at about `:56`–`:73`) deliberately leaves a CEL or runtime-token default unseeded. The client cannot evaluate it, and the server resolves it at insert.
- The field opens empty, or on "Select an option", with nothing that says a value will be set.
- **Not in this card:**
  - The option-level `default: true` half is fixed on `main` by objectui PR #11944 (#11914, closed), after the 17.7.0 pin `0abd4f9f`. It ships with the next console release.

## Done when (the cheapest truthful fix; ⛔ no client-side CEL evaluation, ⛔ no new server door in this card)
- An empty field whose default the server resolves shows that it will be set on save, with a placeholder or hint naming it.
- **Measure** a required field with a CEL default.
  - If the form blocks Save on it, that is a defect in this card: the server fills it, so the form must not refuse.
  - Pin the measured behaviour either way.
- Pins:
  - the hint on a CEL default;
  - CONTROL: a literal default is seeded as today.

`domain:ui` · p3.
